svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build the strip base, case Back / Sides, Bottom / Top, shelves and hanging rail.
2. Build this wardrobe's TWO drawers as its own subassemblies.
3. HOLD runner / hinge dependent drilling and sizing: the old 400 mm slides do not fit.
4. Confirm the proposed 350 mm slides and door clearance before completing those drawers.
5. Trial-fit door; level and anchor the wardrobe before loading it.
